4. Slide-number badge: draw a small yellow #FFFF99 filled circle at the top-right corner (center ≈ x94%, y6%); center a black #000000 '5' inside it.
5. Plot frame: draw a large rectangle with thin red #C00000 border and no fill spanning ≈ x5–95%, y12–92% of the slide.

11. Projection: place one purple/magenta #B000B0 dot on the regression line near its midpoint; from this dot draw a horizontal purple #B000B0 dashed line to the y-axis and a vertical purple #B000B0 dashed line down to the x-axis, terminating in a purple #B000B0 dot on the x-axis.
12. Cursor icon: add a small gray #808080 pen/pointer cursor icon immediately right of the upper end of the regression line (≈ x55%, y30%).

Model (Line) box: draw a pale yellow/cream #FFFFCC filled rectangle with a thin border at ≈ x65–85%, y50–75%; inside, four lines: 'Model ( Line )' with 'Model' in red #C00000 italic bold and '( Line )' in green #008000 italic bold; 'y = a x + b' in purple #800080 italic; 'Weight = a * Length + b' in blue #0000CC italic bold; 'Model Parameters : a , b' in blue #0000CC italic with the substring 'a , b' in red #C00000.
